tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Key facts about NetSendo: what it is, its pricing model (flat price with unlimited contacts, no per-contact fees), license (source-available EULA, not OSI open source), deployment with Docker or NetSendo Cloud, current version, AI and SMS providers, integrations, links and company details.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: NetSendo license plans with prices in USD and features: SILVER (free) and GOLD (monthly or yearly), plus NetSendo Cloud hosting plans. Link users to the url field for current details.

tools.name: compare_platforms
tools.description: Prices at 10k, 50k and 100k contacts and 15 features (automation, SMS, CRM pipeline, webinars, MCP, API, self-hosting…) of NetSendo and other email marketing tools such as Mailchimp, MailerLite, Kit, Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, Brevo, GetResponse, listmonk, Mautic, Keila and Sendy. tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Most recent NetSendo releases from GitHub, newest first, with date, highlights and release notes URL.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search NetSendo blog articles about email marketing, deliverability, automation and product updates by words in the title or excerpt. Returns slug, title, excerpt and url, newest first. Omit q to list the latest articles.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Full text of one blog article as Markdown, by slug from search_blog. Falls back to English when the article has no translation in the requested locale. Cite the url field.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find the NetSendo documentation page or step-by-step how-to for a task, e.g. "connect Amazon SES", "double opt-in", "import contacts from Mailchimp", "update NetSendo", "emails not sending". Returns title, url, the NetSendo release the page was checked against and the best-matching passage. Read the

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Documentation pages (installation, configuration, API, webhooks, AI providers, MCP, n8n) and step-by-step how-to articles for tasks in the NetSendo panel. Use get_doc with an id to read one, or search_docs to find the right one.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: One documentation page as Markdown, by id from list_docs (e.g. "docs-quickstart"). English.

tools.name: get_my_release_alerts
tools.description: Whether the signed-in user's email address is subscribed to NetSendo release alerts (one email per release). Requires OAuth scope alerts:read.

tools.name: subscribe_release_alerts
tools.description: Subscribes the signed-in user's own verified email address to NetSendo release alerts. Idempotent. Requires OAuth scope alerts:write.

tools.name: unsubscribe_release_alerts
tools.description: Unsubscribes the signed-in user's email address from NetSendo release alerts. Requires OAuth scope alerts:write.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_plans, compare_platforms, list_releases, search_blog, get_blog_post, search_docs, get_my_release_alerts · Private data: get_product_facts, compare_platforms, search_docs · Public sink: get_product_facts, compare_platforms, search_blog, get_blog_post, get_my_release_alerts, subscribe_release_alerts, unsubscribe_release_alerts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_plans, compare_platforms, list_releases, search_blog, get_blog_post, search_docs, get_my_release_alerts · Private data: get_product_facts, compare_platforms, search_docs · Public sink: get_product_facts, compare_platforms, search_blog, get_blog_post, get_my_release_alerts, subscribe_release_alerts, unsubscribe_release_alerts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
